Dear Hiring Manager,

Growing a newsletter audience from 640 to 1,150 subscribers in a single summer taught me that the most effective marketing is specific, timely, and built around what an audience actually wants. That instinct for audience-first thinking is exactly what Coinbase needs as it deepens relationships across Consumer and Institutional communities through high-impact experiential programs.

My background sits at the intersection of content, community, and live activation. At Westbrook Film Society, I managed the full promotional cycle for recurring screening events, coordinating creative assets in Canva and CapCut, tracking attendance patterns through Instagram Insights, and building post-event content that drove average ticket sales from 35 to 60 per screening. At Harbor Street Pet Supply, I helped plan and execute a weekend adoption event that drew around 300 visitors, handling on-the-day logistics and post-event social coverage. These experiences gave me a practical foundation in audience coordination, creative production, and measuring what worked, skills I am ready to grow into the full event lifecycle that this role requires.

I would welcome the chance to talk through how my background maps to Coinbase's experiential calendar and what I could contribute from day one.

Sincerely,
Maya Linden

My background in content, community engagement, and event support is early-stage, but I've consistently turned limited resources into measurable results, including growing a newsletter list from 640 to 1,150 subscribers and lifting screening attendance from 35 to 60 tickets per event. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I'm available for a call any weekday and happy to work around your schedule.

Best regards,
Maya Linden
